leads.topic: Measured, bounded reads for each TIFF layout and the 3 GB target
leads.status: unresolved; blocks any broad performance claim
leads.next_step: Build a fixture matrix for supported TIFF/BigTIFF families and measure actual segment/tile reads, peak RSS, cancellation and first-display latency on the stated machine class. Select the support boundary from results.
leads.plan_effect: Direct read-only TIFF support is conditional on a bounded reader path. A file extension or library feature list is not sufficient evidence.

leads.topic: Coordinate behavior at the napari adapter and CSV/save boundary
leads.status: Open issue in captured state; no completed fix/test chain identified
leads.next_step: Prototype only the adapter path needed by the project; test GUI and programmatic layer creation, transforms, save/reopen, 2D/3D and export. Keep project-owned coordinates authoritative until that matrix passes.
leads.plan_effect: Do not make a napari layer CSV or serialized layer state the project's canonical annotation record.

leads.topic: Zarr sharded write integrity and failure recovery
leads.status: Fix chain reaches Zarr-Python v3.1.3; the added test checks GET granularity, not original data equality
leads.next_step: Reproduce issue #3169 with the selected package; add array equality/checksum tests, concurrent and partial writes, fresh-handle reopen, cancellation and interrupted-store recovery.
leads.plan_effect: Use a fixed release and shard-aware scheduling; keep any derived mask store staged and verifiable. Do not count the upstream request-count regression test as proof of data integrity.

leads.topic: Micro-Manager MMStack numeric strings in calibration metadata
leads.status: A source fix is present in tifffile 2026.9.15 commit; the captured fix commit adds no regression test
leads.next_step: Retain a representative archived fixture, verify displayed axes/origin/spacing/time calibration and metadata preservation with the exact packaged tifffile build, and decide whether this vendor family belongs in v1.
leads.plan_effect: Useful support candidate, not a blanket MMStack compatibility promise. If a value cannot be parsed, surface unknown calibration rather than silently inventing a scale.

leads.topic: Atomic publication and flush semantics on ordinary shared storage
leads.status: Unknown for the lab's actual filesystem and sync workflow
leads.next_step: Test staging, file and directory flush, rename, lock contention and recovery on each shared storage type used by the six researchers. Use local working copies where semantics are insufficient.
leads.plan_effect: The proposed generation-pointer protocol is an engineering design, not a guarantee of network-share transactions. Bundle exchange is in scope; simultaneous merge is not.

leads.topic: Zarr Vectors for spatially indexed, very large annotation collections
leads.status: Preserved for later evaluation; draft specification and evolving implementation
leads.next_step: If annotations grow to point clouds, tracks, meshes or spatial query workloads, compare the draft geometry/store model and the Python API stability/conformance story against the project's simple vector schema and common interchange needs.
leads.plan_effect: Keep an adapter opportunity. Do not make this draft format a v1 dependency for ordinary points, plane polygons and masks.

leads.topic: Normalize all input to a chunked OME-Zarr working copy
leads.next_step: Benchmark a copy-on-import path only for file classes that fail bounded direct reading. Verify sample equality or document dtype/interpolation conversion; preserve original source and transformation provenance.
leads.plan_effect: Offers one uniform lazy-read format and potential pyramids at the cost of time, storage and another artifact whose identity/recovery must be managed.

leads.topic: Collaboration beyond exchanging bundles, automatic segmentation and registration
leads.next_step: Revisit only after single-user project identity, coordinate export and recoverable bundle exchange are reliable; assess whether actual lab workflows require conflict merging or automated operations.
leads.plan_effect: Keep these as later alternatives. They add coordination, provenance and validation needs and should not displace the current reliability work.
